Third-party material in Inkwell

This file and the licence files it names are installed with the app, in its resource folder under
licenses/ (see "resources" in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json).

Noto Sans, Noto Sans Mono
  Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors (https://github.com/notofonts/latin-greek-cyrillic)
  Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1: licenses/OFL-NotoSans.txt
  Subsets of NotoSans-Regular/Bold/Italic/BoldItalic and NotoSansMono-Regular/Bold are compiled into the
  app as fallback faces for editing text (sources and ranges: third_party/fonts/README.md in the source).

Noto Sans CJK
  Copyright 2014-2021 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/), with Reserved Font Name 'Source'.
  Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1: licenses/OFL-NotoSansCJK.txt
  A subset of NotoSansCJKsc-Regular is compiled into the app as the fallback face for CJK text.

pdfcraft
  Parts of Inkwell's source are adapted from pdfcraft, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0:
  licenses/pdfcraft/LICENSE-MIT, licenses/pdfcraft/LICENSE-APACHE and licenses/pdfcraft/NOTICE.
  The adapted files are listed in third_party/pdfcraft/INKWELL-NOTICE.txt in the source.

Fluent UI System Icons
  Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft Corporation
  Licensed under the MIT licence: licenses/fluent/LICENSE-MIT
  The interface icons in src/assets/icons/fluent/ are copied from @fluentui/svg-icons (see docs/icons.md).
